neighbours.label: the token that sets up a stock 'a few' completion: ' name' in 'to name a few' (and German 'ein' before 'paar'), as against 'name' or 'ein' in ordinary use and other open-ended list endings

Bees pollinate apples, almonds and cherries, to name a few crops.
She has lived in Paris, Rome and Cairo, to name only a few cities.
The library offers chess, yoga and knitting clubs, to name a few.
Der Lehrer hatte noch ein paar Minuten Zeit.
Wir bleiben noch ein paar Tage in Berlin.
Copper, zinc and tin are mined in the region, to name a few.
